formats.description: Plain transcript text. With timestamps, one "[m:ss] line" per caption.
The full VideoContext as JSON: metadata, chapters, timed segments, and how it was produced.
Markdown transcript: title and metadata, chapters as headings, paragraphs prefixed with timestamp links. Options: linkTimestamps, includeComments, includeVisual.
SubRip (.srt) captions: at most 2 lines of 42 characters per cue, no overlaps, for players and editors.
WebVTT (.vtt) captions for the HTML <track> element, with speaker voice tags when known.
Context pack: one Markdown file for one or many videos, written for an AI model to read, with citation instructions. Options: maxTokens, includeComments, includeVisual, linkTimestamps.
